requirements:
# Dual-Word Edge Detection

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)

## Requirements

Write a function block FB that checks for rising and falling edges in each bit of a dual-word (DWord) input value every cycle. The function block should be able to detect and report changes, rising edges, and falling edges in the input value.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `value` | `DWORD` | The input value to be checked for changes and edge triggering |
| Output | `hasChanged` | `BOOL` | True indicates that the input value has changed |
| Output | `hasRisingEdges` | `BOOL` | True indicates that rising edges have occurred in the input value |
| Output | `risingBits` | `DWORD` | The bit stream of rising edges, where each bit indicates whether the corresponding input bit has experienced a rising edge (1 for a rising edge, 0 for no rising edge) |
| Output | `noOfRisingBits` | `USINT` | The number of rising edges in the input value |
| Output | `hasFallingEdges` | `BOOL` | True indicates that falling edges have occurred in the input value |
| Output | `fallingBits` | `DWORD` | The bit stream of falling edges, where each bit indicates whether the corresponding input bit has experienced a falling edge (1 for a falling edge, 0 for no falling edge) |
| Output | `noOfFallingBits` | `USINT` | The number of falling edges in the input value |

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Previous value is updated after calculating both edge masks.
assumptions: The previous DWORD is initialized to DWORD#0. Therefore nonzero bits on the first scan count as rising edges.
Bitwise complement is restricted to 32 bits; counts range from 0 through 32.
The specification_contract is normative and supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

ltl.explanation: The rising mask identifies only 0-to-1 bits.
The falling mask identifies only 1-to-0 bits.
A bit cannot rise and fall in one scan.
Both counts equal their mask population.
Flags match masks and value changes.
The current value is the next scan history.
The complete per-invocation relation defined in specification_contract.normative_completion; requires explicit encoding before model checking.

atomic_propositions.prev: Ghost pre-scan previous DWORD; initialized to zero.
atomic_propositions.risingBits: End-of-scan mask value & NOT prev, restricted to DWORD width.
atomic_propositions.fallingBits: End-of-scan mask prev & NOT value, restricted to DWORD width.
atomic_propositions.popcount: Number of set bits in the unsigned 32-bit argument.
atomic_propositions.other interface names: Identically named sampled inputs or observed outputs.
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehaviorV2: 明确risingBits/fallingBits始终指实际输出；另定义riseExpected=value & (~prev & 16#FFFFFFFF)、fallExpected=prev & (~value & 16#FFFFFFFF)。比较实际值与期望值；初始prev=0，每拍结束只更新一次prev。计数域0..32，按无符号DWORD处理。

tests.purpose: No change, mixed edges, full width and bit 31
First nonzero invocation is compared with initialized zero

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion: 明确risingBits/fallingBits始终指实际输出；另定义riseExpected=value & (~prev & 16#FFFFFFFF)、fallExpected=prev & (~value & 16#FFFFFFFF)。比较实际值与期望值；初始prev=0，每拍结束只更新一次prev。计数域0..32，按无符号DWORD处理。
specification_contract.history_binding: Every previous-output name refers to the preceding observed output with the declared initial value. Previous-input memories update on EVERY invocation, including reset, invalid input, stop and mode change. Reference phase/history is independently advanced from sampled inputs by the stated transition rules, never supplied by the candidate.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Properties include interpreted data predicates. No claim of export to a model checker or completed formal proof.
